## Jev inbox triage (shadow mode)
Labels and alerts only. Nothing is sent to customers.

1. Gmail credential on the trigger and the 4 label nodes
2. Header Auth credential on **Ask Jev**: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <TypeSafe key>`
3. Create the 4 Gmail labels, pick one per label node
4. Slack channel on **Alert: Human now**
5. Google Sheet for the shadow report on **Log to sheet**
6. Edit STORE in **Build Jev request** for this client

nodes.name: Log to sheet
nodes.notes: Shadow report: one row per email with every Jev score.

nodes.name: Label: Human now
nodes.notes: Pick the Gmail label "Jev/1 Human now" (create it in Gmail first).

nodes.name: Label: Human queue
nodes.notes: Pick the Gmail label "Jev/2 Human queue" (create it in Gmail first).

nodes.name: Label: Automated
nodes.notes: Pick the Gmail label "Jev/3 Would automate" (create it in Gmail first).

nodes.name: Label: Archived
nodes.notes: Pick the Gmail label "Jev/4 Would archive" (create it in Gmail first).
